AWS now uses the existing workspace, module rail, Guide, search, Details inspector with two tabs, Display, Camera, Interface key, Explore, connection navigator and requirement tour. The standalone AWS iframe/UI is removed. First entry preserves the selected architecture layers; use Full Architecture for all 35 capabilities and 68 interfaces.

Lambda, Bedrock/AgentCore and regional managed services are outside customer VPC task boxes. Construction and Assurance task pools show eligible AZ placement; endpoint policies and scoped roles are explicit. Owner attestation enters through the Control-hosted API. Completion/provenance is distinct from independent acceptance. External domain systems remain outside the AWS organization. Foundation summaries contain separate physical account boxes.

## Limits

- No AWS infrastructure deployment or cloud runtime/security/capacity tests were performed.
- DOM/event tests use actual parent scripts under linkedom/Node VM with WebGL unavailable; they are not rendered-browser tests.
- Original Reference data, Three.js bundle and Concept geometry were compared byte-for-byte/structurally to the opened Site snapshot.
- RTO/RPO, quotas, service/model geography, end-to-end SLO and hostile-code isolation remain implementation decisions and tests.

The source snapshot digest is `6a00568419c9d4fd2d4ceccac30fe0b6b45737aabb78ba00210609f095fa97af`. Diagram/UI checks do not establish formal correctness, novelty, secure deployment or empirical business performance. The security/fault tests in Security-and-Operations.md and the presenter brief are required tests for a future implementation, not claims of tests already performed in AWS.
